Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]New Update:[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]New Dialogue everytime they are growing! The noticing! :) [/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][b]Important:[/b][/size]

[size=4][color=#f4cccc]Hey, please don’t forget: if you enjoy the mod, consider leaving an endorsement.

If I get a lot of endorsements, I’ll know that you like the mod — and then I’ll create more female NPCs in the same style.[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I played with my current Curves of Affection and to be hones i did not like it very much! The animation were not clean and a little bit annoying i think! So i decided to make another reloaded mod! NOW with seasonal outfits Summer/Winter AND the Spring/fall outfits also change a little after getting a new "Size" !! [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You need APF for this, because of future maybe animation i will add AND for the GMCM options! [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install APF[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Delete old Curves of affection mod if your installed it[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Install this mod! [/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Seasonal outfits Summer/Winter[/color][/size]
